decisions: reasoning_effort and reasoning_format fields are correctly wired and safe to merge
Default binding configs should use reasoning_effort=none for bounded deterministic tasks on hybrid reasoning models to avoid token budget exhaustion
gpt-oss-20b at effort=low is well-balanced for cognitive operations
qwen3.6-27b at effort=default requires max_tokens >= 1024 for complete output on complex tasks
